integrity: The claim is supported by a direct forcing schedule and an explicit nonnegative-integer symmetric matrix whose real kernel dimension matches the forcing upper bound; the package contains the complete proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes each spider arm has length at least k+1. No classification is claimed for shorter arms, general trees, semidefinite minimum rank or nonsymmetric matrix families. Finite tests do not replace the infinite proof. Independent mathematical and comprehensive priority audit remain unperformed.
title: Sharp zero forcing and minimum real rank of spider powers with unequal arms
